snippet.title: Hot Dog Reporter Infomercial
snippet.description:
Now available on Steam Early Access!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605350/Hot_Dog_Reporter/

If you're reading this on release, Hot Dog Reporter 0.7.0 just dropped! LOTS of changes, but here are some highlights:

- THREE NEW LEVELS!
- Hot Dog Reporter is officially Steam Deck verified!
- New mechanics, including moving hazards, updrafts, and breakable boxes
- You can pet the cat now!
- Lots of new artwork!

Hot Dog Reporter is a (very early access) game about a hot dog in a hurry.

It's a fast paced 2D platformer with aspirations of telling a weird little story about workers rights and cosmic horrors.

This dog's got some good bones and I can't wait to finish slapping the rest of the meat on them.
